bit_ordering.rule: The rightmost character of a bitstring is qubit 0 (clbit 0 for sampled counts).
bit_ordering.example: For 3 qubits with only qubit 0 in |1>, the Qiskit bitstring is '001'.
bit_ordering.matlab_note: MATLAB quantumState.BasisStates put qubit 1 (Qiskit qubit 0) first, so the MATLAB label for the same state is '100'. Reverse the string to convert in either direction, and add 1 to every qubit index.
bit_ordering.statevector_index: Index i of amplitudes_* has bitstring format(i, '0{n}b') in Qiskit order.
